name: pingaccess-administrative
description: The PingAccess Administrative API allows you to integrate PingAccess into existing systems to perform automation of common tasks, actions and audits. Ping Identity provides intelligent identity and security based services.

name: facetec
description: Facetec offers 3D liveness, 3D face matching, OCR and NFC services. The Facetec Testing API provides a variety of functions for processing a Liveness Check, Enrollment, Authentication, Identity Checks, Age Checks, and Image Comparisons.

name: idnet
description: Id.net allows users to log in to websites and retain a single login throughout their experience. Id.net hosts an API for programmatic integration with any website or application. Id.net also offers support for JavaScript, Actionscript, and Unity3D with language specific SDKs and interfaces. Using the Id.net API, developers can implement features such as login, registration, saving high scores for games, and storing and retrieving other user-specific data.

name: vanguardapp
description: The VanguardApp API manages users in a website and verifies accounts with logins attempts. Developers can authenticate with basic HTTP to make calls that display JSON in return. Vanguard provides advanced PHP Login and User Management services.

name: incognia-platform
description: This is an indirect API that is accessible via the Incognia Location Behavioral Biometric SDK. It is a location technology to understand user behavior and location patterns based on network signals. It allows you to detect physical places visited by users, with data collected that is anonymized with hash and encryption techniques. It provides a way to use location behavior for identity verification and authentication, send hyper contextualized push campaigns and more. Incognia builds services to create a ubiquitous private identity that is based on location behavior, and enables a personalized frictionless experience with mobile applications and connected devices.

name: barcodable
description: The Barcodable API can be used to lookup products by UPC, EAN, or ASIN. The API can also be used to convert between various product codes. Requests can be made from the command line using curl or your programming language of choice. Use the HTTP endpoints below to lookup products and convert between product codes. Contact us at support@barcodable.com with any feature requests or bugs.

name: chrome-credential-management
description: The Chrome Credential Management API is a browser-based API designed to help end users authenticate themselves on the developer's website. The API's functions can get credentials, store credentials, and mediate user sign-in. This enables websites to let users sign in with one click, remember the account a user signed in with, and sign users back in when a session expires.

name: virgil-security
description: Virgil Security is a cloud based encryption and authentication platform. It can be used to easily add a security layer to existing applications. It features at rest and transfer encryption, and identity verification. When used within an enterprise, this platform can be integrated with business processes and protect against internal and external threats. Cloud applications can be secured with paswordless authentication and end to end encryption; each device is secured with its own key.

name: autodesk-forge-oauth
description: The Autodesk Forge OAuth API returns a Token that is included in subsequent Forge API calls. OAuth 2 with JSON data format must be used in order to successfully obtain a Token. Autodesk is a California based design and business firm that provides industry leading software such as AutoCAD, Maya, and Fusion 360.
